{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check rows where customer_age is -1
invalid_age_rows = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] == -1]
print('Rows with invalid age (-1):')
print(invalid_age_rows)

# Check if these rows are among those who converted
converted_with_invalid_age = invalid_age_rows[invalid_age_rows['converted'] == 1]
print('\nConverted customers with invalid age (-1):')
print(converted_with_invalid_age)

# Drop rows with invalid age (customer_age == -1) for the analysis
valid_sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Filter for customers who converted
converted_customers_valid = valid_sales_df[valid_sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute the mean customer_age for converted customers with valid age
mean_age_converted_valid = converted_customers_valid['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the result
print('\nMean age of converted customers with valid age:', mean_age_converted_valid)"}
